title: Dimension drop for intersections of Cantor sets
summary: Let $E\subset \mathbb{R}$ be a self-similar set generated by a homogeneous iterated function system $Φ$ with contraction ratio $ρ\in (0,1)$. Assume that $Φ$ satisfies the open set condition and $\dim_{\rm H}E<1$. Let $f$ be a $C^1$-diffeomorphism on $\mathbb{R}$. We prove that if $\log|f'(x)|/\logρ\not\in\mathbb{Q}$ for every $x\in E\cap f^{-1}(E)$, then the upper Minkowski dimension of $f(E)\cap E$ is strictly less than the Hausdorff dimension of $E$. We also establish a quantitative dimension drop result when $E$ is a missing-digit set and $f$ is an affine map with rational slope…
